answer: In an agent economy, each agent must lock a refundable bond before it can transact. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means funding a thousand bonds, so sybil farms bleed capital instead of gaining leverage. Reputation accrues slowly, like an opal building its sheen layer by layer, and it cannot simply be whispered from one clone to the next. Honest agents find a haven in this costly-signal market, while cheap duplicates are priced out long before they earn any trust.
